title: pack.json — a lens pack manifest
description: A lens pack manifest at skills/verdict/packs/builtin/pack.json: the published format fetch resolves into the bundle. The schema closes the shape; the loader also enforces the caps (64 KiB/file, 1 MiB/pack, 256 files, 64 lenses) and the rule that every lens and rule id names its own markdown file. A file no manifest row names is counted but never loaded. Manifest keys must be spelled exactly as published: the loader refuses any other case.

name.description: Pack identity as <namespace>/<slug>, for example verdict/builtin.

version.description: Pack semver; fetch prints <name>@<version> on every plan group line.

replace.description: Lower-layer pack names this pack may override by id. Replacement is downward only: naming a pack at the same or a higher layer refuses pack-conflict.

severity.description: The pack's severity names mapped to critical, important, or informational; every rule's severity key must exist here.

lenses.description: One row per lens; a pack must declare lenses or rules. The loader refuses more than 64 lenses with pack-too-large. Each id names lenses/<id>.md.

rules.description: One row per KB rule; each id names rules/<id>.md, globs are required, and the severity key resolves through this pack's severity map.

lens.description: One lens row: its id, optional group-file globs, and the dispatch caps. A lens with no globs is offered for every plan group; a lens whose globs match none of a group's files is not offered for that group.

id.description: Lowercase slug; the body is lenses/<id>.md and the file stem must equal the id.

globs.description: Optional slash-path globs matched with the repository-config dialect; absent means every plan group.

max_files.description: Dispatch scope cap, 1..24 files; the shipped reviewer contract states at most ~12.

max_findings.description: Dispatch return cap, 1..20 findings; the shipped reviewer contract states at most 10.

rule.description: One rule row: a KB id, the severity-map key that resolves its level, required scope globs, and the tools it talks about.

id.description: KB id grammar: a lowercase slug of at most 65 characters; the body is rules/<id>.md.

severity.description: Key into the manifest severity map; the mapped value is the rule's published severity.

globs.description: Required slash-path globs; a rule that matches no changed file is not recalled.

tools.description: Optional tool names the rule talks about.
